root_causes: Two-pipeline naming mismatch: the memory DB's captions/dialogue transcription named the boss by its narrative/dialogue name ('coffin cart / five-step walking cart'), while the reference answer uses the distinct on-screen HUD boss-bar name ('Brown Iron Tank'/rust-iron chariot); the two names refer to the same entity but neither is a paraphrase of the other, so no amount of DB text search would surface the reference wording.

The on-screen HUD name text is small, low-contrast (white text on dark background) and only visible in a narrow, specific screen region; only 1 of 5 rollouts even attempted to crop and OCR that exact region, and it misread the characters.
Most rollouts (1, 2, 3) never asked clip_qa to explicitly read/zoom the boss name-bar text, defaulting instead to the DB's dialogue-derived label.
Rollout-4 cropped the wrong vertical band (captured the health bar itself, not the name label above it), causing a spurious 'not legible' result and a fallback to the dialogue name.
what_worked: All 5 rollouts correctly located the target time window (~63960-64020s) matching the clue_intervals.
All 5 rollouts correctly counted exactly 2 distinct death/respawn events, matching the reference's implied count.
Rollout-0 was the only one to attempt a targeted crop/zoom of the boss name-bar text region, showing the right retrieval strategy even though the OCR read was wrong.
transferable_lessons: For 'which named enemy/tank/boss' questions, always explicitly instruct clip_qa to zoom into and OCR the on-screen name/label text (health bar, boss banner) rather than accepting a general visual description -- narrative/dialogue names captured in episode text can differ entirely from the HUD label used as ground truth.

When cropping for HUD text, use frames from mid-fight (not the very first frame) and crop a generous band above the health bar itself, since name labels typically sit just above the bar, not inside it.

Cross-check an OCR'd name against the DB's own dialogue/entity names; if they disagree, treat the OCR read as tentative and try multiple frames/crops before committing, since small stylized game-UI Chinese text is easy to misread at low resolution.

When the DB text pipeline gives one consistent name across episodes/topic_facts but the question format ('which tank') implies a distinct on-screen game-UI label, don't assume the DB name is the reference answer -- verify visually first.
